overall_limitations: Several rubric facts are distributed across separate claims. Partial statements receive no full rubric key unless the individual claim adequately expresses it; supporting quotations do not add assertions to claim text.
The claims omit reader end-mark initialization, the shared-memory index's host restriction, single-writer concurrency, reciprocal hook replacement, and attached-database error continuation rules.
S1 and S2 differ in their descriptions of RESTART/TRUNCATE reader blocking and completion. The mode claims evaluated here follow S2's explicit API conditions.
The packet contains only SQLite documentation. It does not establish independent corroboration, historical coverage, or research saturation.
